title: Review records the fix check writes are readable by merge --reviewed
why: Incidents (coordinator 13:59 CST Nov 12): the records on #2860 and #2904 were unreadable by --reviewed.
note: R55 express (merge flow). The lane also takes step review-record-usage-line. Lane id: the session tagged cs-topic:review-record-fix-check-reads; set when it shows. Owner act item 631 (14:05 CST Nov 12): runner 10's express build of #2860 and the cancel of #2814's run were refused by the auto-mode check at 13:24 CST; the owner types his yes in runner 10. Lane 14:20 CST Nov 12 (commit 71b7cf24b): --fix-check HEAD accepted when the PR head holds HEAD, round written in the same record; --reviewed reads the round from an earlier log at the fix check's HEAD. Covers #2904 and #2860 shapes of record-before-fix-push. Lane 15:31 CST Nov 12: #2940 (head 664aafccd) handed in. Open gap: a PR with an unrelated record at another head still refuses a --fix-check line. Retrospective 23:27 CST Nov 12, Degen D25 (batch 3): Degen restarted at round 1 six times on Nov 12 after a passed fix check (597 to 635 to 656; 605 to 667; 645; 674; 567). Root cause read on main 36807ad19, merge/merge.py usage: --fix-check takes HEAD only when it is the Head of the newest earlier record on the PR. #2940 (this step, R55 express) covers a PR with no record at all; the PR-with-other-records case is the open gap above, and is Degen's. Triage 23:29 CST: filed here, not as new step merge-tool-fix-check-no-earlier-log; no owner item, since this step is already express. The lane closes the gap in #2940 or names a follow-up.
